name: AECC Aviation Power Co.,Ltd
summary: AECC Aviation Power Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, sale, and maintenance of aircraft engines and its parts in China and internationally. The company offers large and medium-sized aero-engines, gas turbines, components, and spare parts; general-purpose equipment and motors; and non-aviation and other products. It also provides maintenance and support; equipment installation; aviation equipment repair; and foreign trade export subcontracting services. The company serves the military and civilian markets.
